answer.notes: Dallas motor vehicle theft offenses (NIBRS code 240) in 2024 are counted as distinct (incidentnum, nibrs_code) combinations occurring between 2024-01-01 and 2024-12-31.
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (incidentnum, nibrs_code)) AS offenses FROM stg_dallas_police_offenses WHERE nibrs_code = '240' AND occurred_date >= '2024-01-01' AND occurred_date <= '2024-12-31';

{"sql":"SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT (incidentnum, nibrs_code)) as mvt_2024
FROM stg_dallas_police_offenses
WHERE nibrs_code = '240'
  AND YEAR(occurred_date) = 2024;"}

{"sql":"SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as row_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT incidentnum) as distinct_incidents,
    COUNT(DISTINCT (incidentnum, nibrs_code)) as distinct_offenses
FROM stg_dallas_police_offenses
WHERE nibrs_code = '240'
  AND occurred_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31';"}

{"sql":"SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT (incidentnum, nibrs_code)) AS offenses
FROM stg_dallas_police_offenses
WHERE nibrs_code = '240'
  AND occurred_date >= '2024-01-01'
  AND occurred_date <= '2024-12-31';"}
